COMPRESS
Description
You can use any of several iRule
COMPRESS
commands to manage the
compression of HTTP responses or, beginning in version 11, requests.
NOTE:
The features contained in this namespace require a feature
addon module license to be accessed. These commands will not function
if your system does not have this license installed. For more
information, read about the
License Details
.
Command List
COMPRESS::buffer_size
- Sets the
compression buffer size.
COMPRESS::disable
- Disables
compression for the current HTTP response.
COMPRESS::enable
- Enables compression
for the current HTTP response.
COMPRESS::gzip
- Sets HTTP data
compression criteria.
COMPRESS::method
- Specifies the
preferred compression algorithm.
COMPRESS::nodelay
- desc tbd
